scientific.integrity: The no-go is proved analytically from unitary covariance and semigroup composition. The frequency-limit observation is supplementary. The cited Uhrig model was inspected to distinguish its microscopic pure-dephasing setting from the source's channel-level depolarizing model; finite computational checks are corroborative only.
scientific.limitations: The result is confined to the fixed isotropic qubit depolarizing CPTP map and its isotropic semigroup realization under unitary pulse control. It does not rule out dynamical decoupling for explicit correlated system-bath models, anisotropic noise, error-correcting encodings, or unrelated preprocessing mechanisms.

title: Unitary-pulse no-go for compressing an isotropic depolarizing channel
